question: What Settings localization contract should OpenClaw support for schema/uiHint-derived config labels, and how should the two open partial PRs be sequenced?
rationale: UI chrome can follow the generated locale pipeline, but schema-derived labels cross config metadata and generated-locale boundaries while two open PRs already overlap this Settings area.

options.title: Define One Settings I18n Contract
options.body: Sponsor a single key/fallback design for Settings chrome, Quick Settings, section metadata, and schema labels, then ask contributors or ClawSweeper to rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

options.title: Land Chrome Slices First
options.body: Review and land toolbar or Quick Settings localization as narrow PRs while keeping schema-derived labels tracked here as explicit follow-up work.

options.title: Defer Schema-Label Localization
options.body: Limit near-term work to fixed Settings UI chrome and keep schema-derived config labels English until maintainers want a broader config metadata translation API.

recommendation.title: Define One Settings I18n Contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a single key/fallback design for Settings chrome, Quick Settings, section metadata, and schema labels, then ask contributors or ClawSweeper to rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Settings UI history makes steipete the best available routing candidate for the UX/API sequencing choice, with i18n contributors involved for implementation details.
